segment_captions.caption: A man holds a baby in a swimming pool while another person stands nearby. The baby is wearing a red swimsuit and appears to be splashing water. The man is partially submerged in the water, and the baby is being gently supported by him. Another person's head is visible in the foreground, suggesting they are also in the pool.
C holds a baby in the pool while looking at them.
C holds baby in swimming pool while another person assists baby in water.
A man holds a baby in the water while another person assists nearby. The baby is wearing a pink swimsuit and appears to be looking around. The man smiles and looks at the baby.
C holds baby in swimming pool while another person assists nearby. Baby moves arms and legs in water.
C holds baby A in the water while baby B is held by man X.
C holds baby A while baby B looks around the pool. Baby A reaches out towards baby B.
C holds baby while talking to man in pool. Man adjusts baby's position slightly.

C holds child's head underwater while woman watches and assists.

C swims towards the edge of the pool while holding a child. A woman stands by the poolside, gesturing with her hands near the water's surface. The child appears to be learning to swim under C's guidance. The scene shifts to show a man standing outside the pool area, looking into the water.

A man holds a child in the pool while other children swim nearby. The man appears to be interacting with the child, possibly teaching them to swim or playing with them. The water is calm, and the setting seems to be an indoor swimming pool with a clear view of the outside through the glass wall.
